exposure: color Doppler imaging indices (umbilical artery, uterine artery, middle cerebral artery [MCA])
outcome: neonatal intensive care unit admission rate
cohort: The study included 120 pregnant women, comprising both a study group identified as high-risk and a control group, who attended a gynecology and obstetrics clinic.
finding: Abnormal color Doppler indices of the uterine artery, umbilical artery, and MCA consistently correlated with poor perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Women with abnormal Doppler indices showed a high incidence of cesarean section.
